Clear terms

No long contracts.
No unclear ownership.

Monthly plans run month to month. You can end your plan with 30 days' written notice.

Your business retains ownership of its domains, accounts, core files and data. When an engagement ends, we return your data or securely delete it within 14 days, depending on what you choose.

Third-party services such as hosting, domains, software subscriptions, cloud licences and paid plugins are billed separately unless your written proposal says otherwise.

Common questions

Simple answers before you start.

Are the plans really monthly?+

Yes. Monthly plans run month to month. There is no long-term contract, and you can end your plan with 30 days' written notice.

What counts as a routine website update?+

Routine updates include small text, image, link, product, contact-detail or content changes to existing pages. New functionality, major redesigns, new pages and complex development work are scoped separately before work begins.

What happens to our data if we leave?+

Your business keeps ownership of its data and core accounts. When the engagement ends, we return your data or securely delete it within 14 days, depending on what you choose.

Which plan is right for us?+

Essentials is usually right for small teams that need core systems protected and maintained. Growth is for businesses that also want automation, stronger performance and regular improvement work. Enterprise is for larger or business-critical operations. If you are unsure, book a consultation and we will recommend the right starting point.

Can we start with a one-time project instead?+

Yes. If you have a defined need—such as a new website, email setup, security improvements, a brand project or team training—you can start with a focused project instead.

Can you build a custom plan?+

Yes. Enterprise support is tailored to the systems, risks and priorities of your business. We can also advise whether a focused Foundation Build is a better first step.
